description: Open start times for a public service, using the same slot rules as the booking page. from_date and to_date are YYYY-MM-DD and at most 31 days apart. Each start is ISO 8601 with the provider's offset, plus a provider-local label.

slug.description: Booking link slug, the part after getappty.com/

timezone.description: IANA zone the dates are in. Defaults to the provider's zone. Slot labels stay in the provider's zone.

to_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 31 days after from_date.

name: find_open_slots
title: Find open slots
